blocks.en: Introduction & Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能說明 Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs) 的定義，及其三大類別（基因治療、體細胞治療、組織工程醫藥品）的差異。
blocks.en: Explain the definition of Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs) and the differences among their three categories (gene therapy, somatic cell therapy, tissue engineered products).

blocks.zh: 理解 autologous（自體）與 allogeneic（異體）製程在批量規模、風險輪廓、設施設計上的根本差異。
blocks.en: Understand the fundamental differences between autologous and allogeneic processes in batch size, risk profile and facility design.

blocks.zh: 掌握 GMP 三大支柱：Design（設計）、Control and Mitigation（管制與緩解）、Monitoring（監控）在 ATMP 製造中的具體要求。
blocks.en: Understand the three pillars of GMP, Design, Control and Mitigation, and Monitoring, and what each requires in ATMP manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 理解 Biological Safety Level (BSL) 的概念，以及為何 BSL 是 ATMP 設施設計中的首要考量，優先於產品品質。
blocks.en: Understand the concept of Biological Safety Level (BSL) and why BSL is the first consideration in ATMP facility design, taking priority over product quality.

blocks.zh: 認識本文件涵蓋的主要技術：biosafety cabinets (BSCs)、isolators、closed systems，及其在 ATMP 製造中的適用場景。
blocks.en: Recognize the main technologies covered in this document, biosafety cabinets (BSCs), isolators and closed systems, and where each applies in ATMP manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 能正確使用本文件所有縮寫，並理解其繁體中文對應術語。
blocks.en: Use all the abbreviations in this document correctly and know their Traditional Chinese equivalents.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：三種廚房等級
blocks.en: Analogy: Three Levels of Kitchen

blocks.zh: 把 ATMP 製造設備想像成廚房的三個等級：
blocks.en: Think of ATMP manufacturing equipment as three levels of kitchen:

blocks.zh: 開放式 BSC = 裝有抽油煙機的家用廚房：保護廚師（操作員），但外界空氣仍可進入
blocks.en: Open BSC = a home kitchen with a range hood: it protects the cook (the operator), but outside air can still enter

blocks.zh: 開放式隔離器 = 餐廳明廚的玻璃隔間：有物理分隔，但有開口可傳遞物品
blocks.en: Open isolator = the glass partition of a restaurant open kitchen: there is a physical separation, but openings allow items to be passed through

blocks.zh: 封閉式隔離器 = 完全密封的無菌操作艙：外界空氣無法進入，操作員透過手套操作
blocks.en: Closed isolator = a fully sealed aseptic operating chamber: outside air cannot enter, and the operator works through gloves

blocks.zh: 隔離程度越高，對產品與操作員的保護越好，但彈性越低、成本越高。
blocks.en: The higher the degree of separation, the better the protection of product and operator, but the lower the flexibility and the higher the cost.

blocks.zh: 關鍵技術術語預覽
blocks.en: Key Technical Terms Preview

blocks.zh: 本文件中兩個最核心的設備對比貫穿全文：
blocks.en: Two core equipment comparisons run through the whole document:

blocks.zh: BSC（Biosafety Cabinet，生物安全操作台）：主要保護操作員；適合 BSL-1/2 開放操作；需要較高等級的背景環境（Grade B）
blocks.en: BSC (Biosafety Cabinet): mainly protects the operator; suitable for open operations at BSL-1/2; requires a higher-grade background environment (Grade B)

blocks.zh: Isolator（隔離器）：同時保護操作員與產品；封閉式允許較低背景環境（Grade D）；初始成本高但長期運作成本可能較低
blocks.en: Isolator: protects both operator and product; a closed isolator permits a lower-grade background environment (Grade D); higher initial cost, but long-term operating cost may be lower

blocks.zh: Table 4.3-2🔍 和 Table 4.3-3🔍/4.3-4 將提供這兩者的全面比較，是本文件的核心決策工具。
blocks.en: Table 4.3-2🔍 and Table 4.3-3🔍/4.3-4 give a comprehensive comparison of the two and are the core decision tools of this document.

blocks.zh: ATMP 定義與基本特性
blocks.en: ATMP Definition and Basic Characteristics

blocks.zh: ATMP 核心定義
blocks.en: Core Definition of ATMPs

blocks.zh: Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (先進療法醫藥品，ATMPs) 的獨特性在於其原料來自動物或人體的細胞、基因或組織。
blocks.en: Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs) are unique in that their starting materials are cells, genes or tissues from animals or humans.

blocks.zh: 批量（Batch）規模決定製程類型：
blocks.en: Batch size determines the process type:

blocks.zh: Autologous（自體）：取自「患者本人」的細胞/組織，製造後回輸給同一人。每批量極小（有時僅1人份），製程高度個人化，需嚴格的病患身份追蹤（Chain of Identity）。
blocks.en: Autologous: cells/tissues taken from the patient themselves and returned to the same person after manufacture. Each batch is very small (sometimes a single dose for one person), the process is highly personalized, and strict patient identity tracking (Chain of Identity) is required.

blocks.zh: Allogeneic（異體）：來自「健康捐贈者」，可為多位患者製造。批量較大，更接近傳統製藥的規模化生產。
blocks.en: Allogeneic: derived from healthy donors and can be manufactured for multiple patients. Batches are larger and closer to the scale-up production of conventional pharmaceuticals.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：訂製西裝 vs. 現成成衣
blocks.en: Analogy: Made-to-Measure Suit vs. Ready-to-Wear

blocks.zh: Autologous（自體）：如同「訂製西裝」——每件都是為特定顧客量身打造，尺寸、布料完全個人化。做壞了無法替換，交期壓力大。
blocks.en: Autologous: like a "made-to-measure suit": each one is tailored for a specific customer, with size and fabric fully personalized. A ruined suit cannot be replaced, and delivery pressure is high.

blocks.zh: Allogeneic（異體）：如同「高級成衣」——標準化尺碼，生產量大，一個捐贈者的原料可服務數十到數百位患者。
blocks.en: Allogeneic: like "premium ready-to-wear": standardized sizes and large production volumes; the starting material from one donor can serve dozens to hundreds of patients.

blocks.zh: 這個比喻直接影響設施設計：自體製程需要嚴格防止批次混淆（Mix-up），異體製程則更需防止交叉污染（Cross-contamination）。
blocks.en: This analogy directly affects facility design: autologous processes need strict prevention of mix-up, whereas allogeneic processes need more emphasis on preventing cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: 監管要求的重要性
blocks.en: Why Regulatory Requirements Matter

blocks.zh: 文件明確指出：ATMP 臨床試驗用產品（IMP）必須符合與上市授權產品相同的品質標準。
blocks.en: The document states clearly that ATMP investigational medicinal products (IMPs) for clinical trials must meet the same quality standards as products with a marketing authorization.

blocks.zh: 這與小分子藥物不同，許多公司誤以為臨床試驗階段的 ATMP 可以放寬 GMP 要求，但 EMA 與 FDA 均要求等同標準，從第一批 Phase I 起即應如此。
blocks.en: This differs from small-molecule drugs. Many companies wrongly assume that GMP requirements can be relaxed for ATMPs in the clinical trial stage, but both EMA and FDA require an equivalent standard, starting from the first Phase I batch.

blocks.zh: 理解確認練習
blocks.en: Comprehension Check

blocks.zh: 場景：你的公司正在開發 CAR-T 細胞療法，從患者血液中分離 T 細胞，經基因修飾後回輸給同一患者。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your company is developing a CAR-T cell therapy in which T cells are isolated from the patient's blood, genetically modified, and infused back into the same patient.

blocks.zh: 問題：
blocks.en: Questions:

blocks.zh: 這屬於 autologous 還是 allogeneic？
blocks.en: Is this autologous or allogeneic?

blocks.zh: 它主要屬於哪個 ATMP 類別（可能跨類）？
blocks.en: Which ATMP category does it mainly belong to (it may span categories)?

blocks.zh: 批次混淆（Mix-up）的後果是什麼？
blocks.en: What are the consequences of a mix-up?

blocks.zh: 參考答案：①自體（Autologous）；②同時涉及體細胞治療（細胞操作）與基因治療（基因修飾），是常見的跨類產品；③致命風險——錯誤的 T 細胞回輸給不匹配患者。
blocks.en: Reference answer: (1) Autologous. (2) It involves both somatic cell therapy (cell manipulation) and gene therapy (genetic modification), a common cross-category product. (3) A fatal risk: the wrong T cells infused into a mismatched patient.

blocks.zh: GMP 三大支柱：設計、管制與監控
blocks.en: The Three Pillars of GMP: Design, Control and Monitoring

blocks.zh: GMP 三大支柱在 ATMP 製造的詮釋
blocks.en: How the Three GMP Pillars Are Interpreted in ATMP Manufacturing

blocks.zh: GMP 的三大支柱（Design/Control/Monitoring）並非 ATMP 特有，但 ATMP 的特殊性使每個支柱都有獨特的挑戰：
blocks.en: The three pillars of GMP (Design/Control/Monitoring) are not specific to ATMPs, but the particular nature of ATMPs gives each pillar its own challenges:

blocks.zh: Design（設計）：必須在設計初期就決定 open vs. closed vs. hybrid 製程——這個決定決定了 BSL 要求、潔凈室等級、人員流動設計，甚至整棟廠房的架構。
blocks.en: Design: whether the process will be open, closed or hybrid must be decided at the very start of design. This decision determines the BSL requirements, cleanroom grades, personnel flow design and even the architecture of the whole building.

blocks.zh: Control and Mitigation（管制與緩解）：CCS 是核心工具，整合從原物料、製造環境、設備、人員到廢棄物的全面管制。
blocks.en: Control and Mitigation: the CCS is the core tool, integrating comprehensive control from raw materials, the manufacturing environment, equipment and personnel to waste.

blocks.zh: Monitoring（監控）：QTPP 的滿足需要在整個製程中持續監控，包含微生物、微粒、氣流、HVAC 效能。
blocks.en: Monitoring: meeting the QTPP requires continuous monitoring throughout the process, including microbial, particulate, airflow and HVAC performance.

blocks.zh: ATMP 決策優先層級（核心框架）
blocks.en: ATMP Decision Priority Hierarchy (Core Framework)

blocks.zh:
優先順序  考量面向           關鍵問題
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#1        操作員安全          BSL 等級決定？
          (Operator Safety)   負壓還是正壓廠房？
                              需要何種 PPE？

#2        病患安全            無菌保證 SAL 足夠？
          (Patient Safety)    交叉污染風險管控？
                              Chain of Identity 完整？

#3        產品品質            CQAs 是否持續達標？
          (Product Quality)   QTPP 是否滿足？
                              批次記錄完整性？

#4        法規合規            GMP/EudraLex/FDA符合？
          (Regulatory)        授權條件是否達成？

#5        商業靈活性          Autologous vs. Allogeneic
          (Business)          設施多產品能力？
                              成本效益最佳化？
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
注意：BSL 要求（操作員安全）永遠優先！
當 BSL 需求（負壓）與無菌製程（正壓）衝突時，
必須設計特殊的壓力階梯解決方案，而非妥協 BSL。
blocks.en:
Priority  Consideration        Key questions
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#1        Operator safety      What BSL level applies?
          (Operator Safety)    Negative or positive pressure building?
                               What PPE is needed?

#2        Patient safety       Is sterility assurance (SAL) sufficient?
          (Patient Safety)     Is cross-contamination risk controlled?
                               Is Chain of Identity intact?

#3        Product quality      Are CQAs consistently met?
          (Product Quality)    Is the QTPP satisfied?
                               Are batch records complete?

#4        Regulatory           Compliant with GMP/EudraLex/FDA?
          compliance           Are the authorization conditions met?
          (Regulatory)

#5        Business flexibility Autologous vs. Allogeneic
          (Business)           Multi-product capability of the facility?
                               Cost-effectiveness optimization?
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
Note: BSL requirements (operator safety) always come first!
When BSL needs (negative pressure) conflict with aseptic
processing (positive pressure), a special pressure cascade
solution must be designed rather than compromising the BSL.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院手術室的三層把關
blocks.en: Analogy: Three Layers of Safeguards in a Hospital Operating Room

blocks.zh: 將 GMP 三大支柱比喻成醫院手術室的設計：
blocks.en: Compare the three GMP pillars to the design of a hospital operating room:

blocks.zh: Design（設計） = 手術室的建築設計：正壓氣流、雙門氣鎖、專用排水——在動工前就決定，改建代價極高
blocks.en: Design = the architectural design of the operating room: positive-pressure airflow, double-door air locks, dedicated drainage. These are decided before construction starts, and rebuilding is extremely costly.

blocks.zh: Control（管制） = 術前備藥、手術器械滅菌、人員著裝規範——即使設計再好，如果執行不當仍會失敗
blocks.en: Control = pre-operative medication preparation, sterilization of surgical instruments, gowning rules for staff. However good the design, poor execution will still lead to failure.

blocks.zh: Monitoring（監控） = 術中生命監測儀、空氣微粒計、血壓監測——即時確認一切如預期運作，異常立即處置
blocks.en: Monitoring = intra-operative vital sign monitors, air particle counters, blood pressure monitoring. These confirm in real time that everything is working as expected, so that any abnormality is dealt with immediately.

blocks.zh: CCS（污染管制策略）的地位
blocks.en: The Status of the CCS (Contamination Control Strategy)

blocks.zh: CCS 在 ATMP 製造中並非可選項，而是 GMP 法規的強制要求（EudraLex Annex 1, 2022 修訂版正式引入此概念）。
blocks.en: In ATMP manufacturing, the CCS is not optional but a mandatory GMP requirement (the concept was formally introduced in the 2022 revision of EudraLex Annex 1).

blocks.zh: ATMP 的 CCS 特別複雜，因為需要同時處理：
blocks.en: The CCS for ATMPs is particularly complex because it must address several things at once:

blocks.zh: 外源性微生物污染（傳統無菌製程的主要挑戰）
blocks.en: Adventitious microbial contamination (the main challenge of conventional aseptic processing)

blocks.zh: 生物活性物質的交叉污染（病毒載體、GMO、細胞）
blocks.en: Cross-contamination by biologically active materials (viral vectors, GMOs, cells)

blocks.zh: 批次間的身份混淆（特別是 autologous 製程）
blocks.en: Identity mix-up between batches (especially in autologous processes)

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 場景：你的 CDMO 同時承接自體 CAR-T（患者數：20人/月）與異體 NK 細胞（每批 200 人份）的代工服務。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO takes on contract manufacturing of both autologous CAR-T (20 patients/month) and allogeneic NK cells (200 doses per batch).

blocks.zh: GMP 三支柱的應用挑戰：
blocks.en: Challenges in applying the three GMP pillars:

blocks.zh: Design：兩條製程是否共用設施？如共用，隔離機制是物理隔離還是時間隔離？各自的 BSL 要求是否相同？
blocks.en: Design: Do the two processes share a facility? If so, is the segregation physical or temporal? Are the BSL requirements of each the same?

blocks.zh: Control：自體產品的 Chain of Identity SOP 如何設計？異體產品的批次放行標準與自體有何不同？
blocks.en: Control: How should the Chain of Identity SOP for the autologous product be designed? How do batch release criteria for the allogeneic product differ from the autologous one?

blocks.zh: Monitoring：HVAC 監控系統能否同時服務兩條製程的不同壓力梯度要求？
blocks.en: Monitoring: Can the HVAC monitoring system serve the different pressure cascade requirements of both processes at the same time?

blocks.zh: 這些問題沒有標準答案，但 PDA PtC-14 的後續章節將提供決策框架。
blocks.en: These questions have no standard answers, but the later sections of PDA PtC-14 provide a decision framework.

blocks.zh: BSL 生物安全等級：設計的首要考量
blocks.en: BSL Biosafety Levels: The First Consideration in Design

blocks.zh: Biological Safety Level (BSL，生物安全等級) 的定義
blocks.en: Definition of Biological Safety Level (BSL)

blocks.zh: BSL 是基於生物危害程度對工作環境的分級要求：
blocks.en: BSL grades the requirements for the working environment according to the degree of biological hazard:

blocks.zh: BSL-1：對健康成人無已知危害的微生物（如非致病性大腸桿菌）。標準實驗室規範即可，無需特殊設備。
blocks.en: BSL-1: microorganisms with no known hazard to healthy adults (e.g., non-pathogenic E. coli). Standard laboratory practice is sufficient; no special equipment is needed.

blocks.zh: BSL-2：中度潛在危害，可能引起人類疾病但風險可控（如許多病毒載體：AAV、Lentivirus）。需要 BSC II 級操作台、限制人員進出。
blocks.en: BSL-2: moderate potential hazard; may cause human disease but the risk is manageable (e.g., many viral vectors such as AAV and lentivirus). Requires a Class II BSC and restricted personnel access.

blocks.zh: BSL-3：可能引起嚴重疾病，但有治療方法（如結核桿菌、西尼羅河病毒）。本文件不涵蓋此等級。
blocks.en: BSL-3: may cause serious disease, but treatment exists (e.g., Mycobacterium tuberculosis, West Nile virus). This level is not covered by this document.

blocks.zh: BSL-4：可致命且無治療方法（如伊波拉病毒）。本文件不涵蓋此等級。
blocks.en: BSL-4: can be lethal with no treatment available (e.g., Ebola virus). This level is not covered by this document.

（逆轉錄病毒）                        （現較少使用）

（腺病毒）

                                     required)

                                     (now less used)

Adenovirus                BSL-2      Gene therapy, vaccines

Herpesvirus               BSL-2      Gene therapy for
                                     neurological diseases

RCV                       Handle     Key focus of contamination
(Replication-             one level  control during production
Competent Virus)          higher

Note: Non-RCV (non-replicating) viruses carry lower risk than RCV,
but work must still be performed at the corresponding BSL.

blocks.zh: BSL vs. GMP 潔凈室等級：兩套獨立系統
blocks.en: BSL vs. GMP Cleanroom Grades: Two Independent Systems

blocks.zh: 這是 ATMP 設施設計中最常見的混淆點：
blocks.en: This is the most common point of confusion in ATMP facility design:

blocks.zh: BSL（生物安全等級） = 職業安全要求，保護操作員不受生物危害
blocks.en: BSL (Biological Safety Level) = an occupational safety requirement that protects the operator from biological hazards

blocks.zh: GMP 潔凈室等級（Grade A/B/C/D） = 藥品法規要求，保護產品免受微生物污染
blocks.en: GMP cleanroom grades (Grade A/B/C/D) = a pharmaceutical regulatory requirement that protects the product from microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 兩者可能衝突：
blocks.en: The two may conflict:

blocks.zh: BSL-2 傾向負壓（防止危害外洩）
blocks.en: BSL-2 favors negative pressure (to prevent hazards from escaping)

blocks.zh: 無菌區（Grade A/B）傾向正壓（防止污染進入）
blocks.en: Aseptic areas (Grade A/B) favor positive pressure (to prevent contamination from entering)

blocks.zh: 解決方案：使用封閉式隔離器（Closed Isolator）——隔離器內部正壓（保護產品），隔離器外部/廠房負壓（保護操作員）。這是 PtC-14 後續章節的核心設計邏輯。
blocks.en: Solution: use a closed isolator, with positive pressure inside the isolator (protecting the product) and negative pressure outside the isolator/in the building (protecting the operator). This is the core design logic of the later sections of PtC-14.

blocks.zh: 比喻：核電廠的雙重屏障原則
blocks.en: Analogy: The Dual-Barrier Principle of a Nuclear Power Plant

blocks.zh: ATMP 設施的 BSL + GMP 雙重要求，類似於核電廠的設計邏輯：
blocks.en: The dual BSL + GMP requirements of an ATMP facility are similar to the design logic of a nuclear power plant:

blocks.zh: 第一層屏障（BSL）：防止放射性物質（病毒載體/GMO）外洩到環境，保護工作人員與社區
blocks.en: First barrier (BSL): prevents radioactive material (viral vectors/GMOs) from escaping into the environment, protecting workers and the community

blocks.zh: 第二層屏障（GMP）：防止外界污染進入燃料棒（產品），確保核反應的品質與可靠性
blocks.en: Second barrier (GMP): prevents outside contamination from reaching the fuel rods (the product), ensuring the quality and reliability of the nuclear reaction

blocks.zh: 兩個方向完全相反，但設計師必須同時滿足兩者。封閉式隔離器就是這個「雙向屏障」的工程解決方案。
blocks.en: The two act in completely opposite directions, yet the designer must satisfy both. The closed isolator is the engineering solution to this "two-way barrier".

blocks.zh: 三大主流技術的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Logic for Choosing Among the Three Main Technologies

blocks.zh: 文件指出技術選擇不由「商業化階段」決定，而是由「製程彈性需求」決定：
blocks.en: The document states that the choice of technology is determined not by the "stage of commercialization" but by the "need for process flexibility":

blocks.zh: BSC（生物安全操作台）：彈性最高，適合多步驟開放操作；但需要較高潔凈室背景環境（Grade B）
blocks.en: BSC (Biosafety Cabinet): the most flexible, suitable for multi-step open operations; but requires a higher-grade cleanroom background (Grade B)

blocks.zh: Isolator（隔離器）：無菌保證最高（SAL 10⁻⁶），可降低背景環境要求（Grade C/D）；但操作彈性低，初始設備成本高
blocks.en: Isolator: the highest sterility assurance (SAL 10⁻⁶) and permits a lower background grade (Grade C/D); but offers low operational flexibility and high initial equipment cost

blocks.zh: Closed System（封閉系統）：介於兩者之間；適合連續培養、過濾等特定步驟；需搭配滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Closed System: sits between the two; suitable for specific steps such as continuous culture and filtration; requires sterilization validation

blocks.zh: 實務上，ATMP 製程常使用混合模式（Hybrid）——不同製程步驟採用不同技術。
blocks.en: In practice, ATMP processes often use a hybrid approach, with different technologies for different process steps.

blocks.zh: QRM 品質風險管理與文件目的
blocks.en: QRM (Quality Risk Management) and the Purpose of the Document

blocks.zh: QRM（品質風險管理）在 ATMP 中的應用
blocks.en: Application of QRM (Quality Risk Management) in ATMPs

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management (QRM，品質風險管理) 是 ICH Q9 建立的系統性方法，在 ATMP 製造中扮演核心角色：
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (QRM) is a systematic approach established by ICH Q9 and plays a central role in ATMP manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 識別每個製程步驟的風險來源（原物料、環境、操作員）
blocks.en: Identify sources of risk at each process step (raw materials, environment, operators)

blocks.zh: 評估風險對 CQAs（Critical Quality Attributes，關鍵品質屬性）的影響
blocks.en: Assess the impact of risks on CQAs (Critical Quality Attributes)

blocks.zh: 決定哪些風險需要透過設施設計控制，哪些透過製程控制即可
blocks.en: Decide which risks need to be controlled through facility design and which can be handled through process controls

blocks.zh: 建立 QTPP（Quality Target Product Profile，品質目標產品概廓）
blocks.en: Establish the QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile)

blocks.zh: 本文件的設施設計建議，本質上都是 QRM 應用的具體化輸出。
blocks.en: The facility design recommendations in this document are, in essence, concrete outputs of applying QRM.

blocks.zh: 為何需要 PDA PtC-14？法規指引的缺口
blocks.en: Why PDA PtC-14 Is Needed: The Gap in Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: ATMP 製造面臨的核心挑戰：法規指引不足。
blocks.en: The core challenge in ATMP manufacturing is insufficient regulatory guidance.

blocks.zh: 現有主要指引的局限：
blocks.en: Limitations of the main existing guidance:

blocks.zh: EudraLex Annex 2（2023）：針對生物製品，ATMP 部分指引有限
blocks.en: EudraLex Annex 2 (2023): addresses biological products, with limited guidance on ATMPs

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 1271：主要針對 HCT/P（人類細胞/組織產品），不完全適用所有 ATMP
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR Part 1271: mainly addresses HCT/Ps (human cells, tissues, and cellular and tissue-based products) and does not fully apply to all ATMPs

blocks.zh: EMA ATMP 指引：分散於多份文件，缺乏設施設計的整合性指引
blocks.en: EMA ATMP guidance: scattered across several documents, with no integrated guidance on facility design

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-14 填補的就是設施設計（Facility Design）這個特定缺口，以 Q&A 格式提供業界可操作的建議。
blocks.en: PDA PtC-14 fills this specific gap in facility design, offering practical industry recommendations in a Q&A format.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「新興城市的建築法規」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Building Codes for an Emerging City"

blocks.zh: ATMP 製造業就像一個快速成長的新興城市——人口暴增但道路規劃不足。
blocks.en: The ATMP manufacturing industry is like a fast-growing new city: the population has surged but road planning has not kept up.

blocks.zh: 傳統藥廠 = 有完善都市計畫的老城區（GMP 指引成熟）
blocks.en: Conventional pharmaceutical plants = an old district with well-established urban planning (mature GMP guidance)

blocks.zh: ATMP 產業 = 快速開發的新市鎮（技術超前於法規）
blocks.en: The ATMP industry = a rapidly developed new town (technology ahead of regulation)

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-14 = 暫行建築指引——不是法律，但提供各方認可的最佳實踐
blocks.en: PDA PtC-14 = interim building guidance: not law, but best practice recognized by all parties

blocks.zh: 這也解釋了為何文件叫 "Points to Consider"（考量要點）而非 "Requirements"（要求）——它是建議性的，但業界普遍將其視為標準參考。
blocks.en: This also explains why the document is called "Points to Consider" rather than "Requirements": it is advisory, yet the industry widely treats it as a standard reference.

blocks.zh: 技術趨勢：向更高圍堵程度移動
blocks.en: Technology Trend: Moving Toward Greater Containment

blocks.zh: 文件坦率承認行業的發展方向：
blocks.en: The document candidly acknowledges the direction in which the industry is heading:

blocks.zh: 未來趨勢：更大圍堵（Greater Containment）→ 更高無菌保證 → 減少人員介入
blocks.en: Future trend: greater containment → higher sterility assurance → less human intervention

blocks.zh: 具體表現：
blocks.en: In concrete terms:

blocks.zh: 從 BSC 移向封閉式 Isolator
blocks.en: Moving from BSCs to closed isolators

blocks.zh: 從人工操作移向自動化（Robotic cell manufacturing）
blocks.en: Moving from manual operation to automation (robotic cell manufacturing)

blocks.zh: 從多步驟開放製程移向整合性封閉系統（All-in-one bioprocessor）
blocks.en: Moving from multi-step open processes to integrated closed systems (all-in-one bioprocessors)

blocks.zh: 現實限制：目前 ATMP 製程的複雜性與多樣性，使得完全自動化封閉製程在短期內不可行。PtC-14 以務實態度呈現「現有技術」的最佳實踐，而非只描述理想狀態。
blocks.en: Practical limitation: the complexity and diversity of current ATMP processes make fully automated closed processes unfeasible in the short term. PtC-14 takes a pragmatic approach, presenting best practice for "existing technology" rather than describing only the ideal state.

blocks.zh: 批判性思考練習
blocks.en: Critical Thinking Exercise

blocks.zh: 問題：PtC-14 的格式是 Q&A（問答式）而非條文式規定，這有什麼優缺點？對 CDMO 的日常使用有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Question: PtC-14 is in Q&A format rather than prescriptive clauses. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this? What does it mean for a CDMO's day-to-day use?

blocks.zh: 提示角度：
blocks.en: Angles to consider:

blocks.zh: 優點：聚焦實際問題、容易查找；語言更靈活，適應新興技術；提供理由（Rationale），幫助理解法規背後的邏輯
blocks.en: Advantages: focuses on practical issues and is easy to look up; the language is more flexible and adapts to emerging technologies; it provides the rationale, which helps explain the logic behind the requirements

blocks.zh: 缺點：邊界條件不夠清晰；不同解讀可能導致法規稽核爭議；難以直接轉化為 SOP 要求
blocks.en: Disadvantages: boundary conditions are not clear enough; different interpretations may lead to disputes in regulatory inspections; it is hard to translate directly into SOP requirements

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的影響：需要配合客戶的特定需求進行解讀；稽核時可能面臨監管機構對同一 Q&A 有不同解讀的風險
blocks.en: Impact on a CDMO: interpretation must be aligned with each client's specific needs; during inspections there is a risk that the regulator interprets the same Q&A differently

blocks.zh: 高風險術語：RCV vs. Non-RCV
blocks.en: High-Risk Terms: RCV vs. Non-RCV

blocks.zh: 在病毒載體製造中，RCV 與 Non-RCV 的區別至關重要：
blocks.en: In viral vector manufacturing, the distinction between RCV and Non-RCV is critical:

blocks.zh: Non-RCV（非複製型病毒）：設計上無法在宿主細胞內自主複製。用於大多數基因治療——刪除了關鍵複製基因，只保留進入細胞和表達目標基因的能力。BSL 風險相對可控。
blocks.en: Non-RCV (non-replication-competent virus): designed so that it cannot replicate autonomously in host cells. Used for most gene therapies; key replication genes are deleted, leaving only the ability to enter cells and express the target gene. The BSL risk is relatively manageable.

blocks.zh: RCV（複製型病毒）：可在宿主細胞中自主複製，可能持續擴散。通常是生產過程中非預期產生的污染物（如重組事件）。出現 RCV 表示 BSL 風險升級，需立即升級圍堵措施並通報監管機構。
blocks.en: RCV (replication-competent virus): can replicate autonomously in host cells and may continue to spread. It is usually an unintended contaminant of the production process (e.g., through recombination events). The appearance of RCV means the BSL risk has escalated; containment measures must be upgraded immediately and the regulatory authority notified.

blocks.zh: 關鍵監控要求：所有病毒載體批次必須進行 RCV 測試（作為放行標準之一）。
blocks.en: Key monitoring requirement: all viral vector batches must be tested for RCV (as one of the release criteria).

blocks.zh: RTP（快速傳遞口）與 MAL/PAL 的功能差異
blocks.en: Functional Differences Between RTP (Rapid Transfer Port) and MAL/PAL

blocks.zh: 這三個術語都與「物料/人員在不同等級區域間的安全轉移」有關：
blocks.en: All three terms relate to the "safe transfer of materials/personnel between areas of different grades":

blocks.zh: RTP（快速傳遞口，Rapid Transfer Port）：隔離器壁上的小型快速傳遞裝置，用於傳遞小型物品（如培養皿、針筒）而不破壞隔離器完整性。Alpha port（隔離器側）與 Beta port（容器側）配合使用。
blocks.en: RTP (Rapid Transfer Port): a small, fast transfer device on the isolator wall, used to pass small items (e.g., culture dishes, syringes) without breaching isolator integrity. The alpha port (isolator side) and the beta port (container side) are used together.

blocks.zh: MAL（物料氣鎖室，Material Air Lock）：房間級別的氣鎖區域，用於大型設備或物料進出，通過氣流壓差和時間延遲確保不同潔凈等級間的隔離。
blocks.en: MAL (Material Air Lock): a room-level air lock area for moving large equipment or materials in and out, which maintains separation between different cleanliness grades through pressure differential and time delay.

blocks.zh: PAL（人員氣鎖室，Personnel Air Lock）：人員進出高等級潔凈室的過渡區域，配合更衣、吹淋（Air Shower）程序。
blocks.en: PAL (Personnel Air Lock): a transition area for personnel entering and leaving higher-grade cleanrooms, used together with gowning and air shower procedures.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院的三種「通道」
blocks.en: Analogy: Three Kinds of "Passage" in a Hospital

blocks.zh: RTP = 手術室門上的小型傳遞窗：用於傳遞手術器械，不需開大門
blocks.en: RTP = a small pass-through window on the operating room door: surgical instruments are passed through without opening the main door

blocks.zh: MAL = 手術室的設備進出通道：大型設備（如 C 臂機）進出，有完整的消毒程序
blocks.en: MAL = the equipment entry/exit passage of the operating room: large equipment (e.g., a C-arm) goes in and out under a full disinfection procedure

blocks.zh: PAL = 手術室的換衣間（更衣室）：人員換上無菌服裝後才能進入手術室
blocks.en: PAL = the changing room of the operating room: staff change into sterile garments before entering the operating room

blocks.zh: VPHP（汽相過氧化氫）在 ATMP 中的角色
blocks.en: The Role of VPHP (Vapor Phase Hydrogen Peroxide) in ATMPs

blocks.zh: VPHP（汽相過氧化氫，Vapor Phase Hydrogen Peroxide） 是 ATMP 設施中最常用的設備去污劑：
blocks.en: VPHP (Vapor Phase Hydrogen Peroxide) is the most commonly used equipment decontaminant in ATMP facilities:

blocks.zh: 用途：隔離器的例行去污（每批次後或定期）；廠房表面去污；BSC 的深度清潔
blocks.en: Uses: routine decontamination of isolators (after each batch or periodically); facility surface decontamination; deep cleaning of BSCs

blocks.zh: 優點：穿透性強、無殘留（分解為水和氧氣）、對廣譜微生物有效（含芽孢）
blocks.en: Advantages: strong penetration, no residue (breaks down into water and oxygen), effective against a broad spectrum of microorganisms (including spores)

blocks.zh: 注意：H₂O₂ 對材料有腐蝕性，設備選材時需考慮相容性；操作員暴露限值需嚴格管控（OSHA：1 ppm TWA）
blocks.en: Cautions: H₂O₂ is corrosive to materials, so compatibility must be considered when selecting equipment materials; operator exposure limits must be strictly controlled (OSHA: 1 ppm TWA)

blocks.zh: ATMP 特殊考量：去污後需充分通風以避免 H₂O₂ 殘留影響細胞活性
blocks.en: ATMP-specific consideration: after decontamination, adequate aeration is needed so that residual H₂O₂ does not affect cell viability

blocks.zh: CFD（計算流體動力學）在設施設計的應用
blocks.en: Application of CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) in Facility Design

blocks.zh: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD，計算流體動力學) 在 ATMP 設施設計中是越來越重要的工具：
blocks.en: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is an increasingly important tool in ATMP facility design:

blocks.zh: 用途：在建造前以電腦模擬廠房或隔離器內的氣流分佈
blocks.en: Use: simulate airflow distribution inside a facility or isolator by computer before construction

blocks.zh: 可評估：污染物擴散路徑、壓差維持效果、HEPA 覆蓋盲點
blocks.en: Can assess: contaminant dispersion paths, how well pressure differentials are maintained, and HEPA coverage blind spots

blocks.zh: 本文件 Figure 4.2-3🔍 展示了封閉式隔離器的 CFD 研究案例
blocks.en: Figure 4.2-3🔍 of this document shows a CFD study case for a closed isolator

blocks.zh: 優點：降低物理建造後再改造的風險和成本；支持 GEP（優良工程規範）中的設計確認
blocks.en: Advantages: reduces the risk and cost of rework after physical construction; supports design qualification under GEP (good engineering practice)

blocks.zh: CDMO 日常應用：縮寫使用場景
blocks.en: CDMO Daily Practice: Where the Abbreviations Appear

blocks.zh: 以下是在 CDMO 環境中，這些縮寫最常出現的文件場景：
blocks.en: The following are the document contexts in which these abbreviations most often appear in a CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: CCS：出現在 Quality Manual、製程驗證方案（PVP）、Annex 1 合規評估報告
blocks.en: CCS: appears in the Quality Manual, process validation protocols (PVP) and Annex 1 compliance assessment reports

blocks.zh: BSL：出現在設施風險評估報告（Facility Risk Assessment）、職業安全計畫（Biosafety Plan）
blocks.en: BSL: appears in the Facility Risk Assessment report and the Biosafety Plan

blocks.zh: EM：出現在環境監控計畫（EM Program）、月度環境趨勢報告
blocks.en: EM: appears in the EM Program and monthly environmental trend reports

blocks.zh: RCV/Non-RCV：出現在批次放行檢測標準（Lot Release Criteria）、QC 測試方法
blocks.en: RCV/Non-RCV: appears in lot release criteria and QC test methods

blocks.zh: VPHP：出現在設備去污驗證報告（Decontamination Validation）、清潔 SOP
blocks.en: VPHP: appears in decontamination validation reports and cleaning SOPs

blocks.zh: RTP：出現在隔離器操作 SOP、物料傳遞程序、防護評估
blocks.en: RTP: appears in isolator operating SOPs, material transfer procedures and containment assessments

blocks.zh: MAL/PAL：出現在廠房設計圖（Facility Layout）、人員物料流動 SOP
blocks.en: MAL/PAL: appears in the facility layout and in personnel and material flow SOPs

blocks.zh: CFD：出現在設施設計階段報告（Design Qualification，DQ）、HVAC 確效方案
blocks.en: CFD: appears in design-stage reports (Design Qualification, DQ) and HVAC qualification protocols

blocks.zh: Section 0 總結 — Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Section 0 Summary: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 核心概念（必記）
blocks.en: Core Concepts (Must Remember)

blocks.zh: ATMPs = 基因治療 + 體細胞治療 + 組織工程醫藥品
blocks.en: ATMPs = gene therapy + somatic cell therapy + tissue engineered products

blocks.zh: Autologous（自體）= 個人化、小批量、高身份追蹤風險
blocks.en: Autologous = personalized, small batches, high identity-tracking risk

blocks.zh: Allogeneic（異體）= 多患者、較大批量、交叉污染為主要風險
blocks.en: Allogeneic = multiple patients, larger batches, cross-contamination as the main risk

blocks.zh: GMP 三支柱：Design → Control & Mitigation → Monitoring
blocks.en: The three pillars of GMP: Design → Control & Mitigation → Monitoring

blocks.zh: BSL 是設施設計的首要考量（操作員安全 #1）
blocks.en: BSL is the first consideration in facility design (operator safety #1)

blocks.zh: 本文件聚焦 BSL-1 和 BSL-2（不涵蓋 BSL-3/4）
blocks.en: This document focuses on BSL-1 and BSL-2 (BSL-3/4 are not covered)

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語（必懂）
blocks.en: Key Terms (Must Understand)

blocks.zh: BSC vs. Isolator：不同保護對象與背景等級要求
blocks.en: BSC vs. Isolator: different objects of protection and different background grade requirements

blocks.zh: CCS：整合所有污染管制措施的戰略性文件
blocks.en: CCS: the strategic document that integrates all contamination control measures

blocks.zh: RCV vs. Non-RCV：決定病毒載體的 BSL 風險等級
blocks.en: RCV vs. Non-RCV: determines the BSL risk level of a viral vector

blocks.zh: RTP / MAL / PAL：不同層級的物料傳遞與人員隔離機制
blocks.en: RTP / MAL / PAL: material transfer and personnel separation mechanisms at different levels

blocks.zh: VPHP：隔離器的首選去污媒介
blocks.en: VPHP: the preferred decontamination agent for isolators

blocks.zh: CFD：設施設計驗證的虛擬工具
blocks.en: CFD: a virtual tool for verifying facility design

blocks.zh: 下一節預告：Topic 1 — Risk Management
blocks.en: Coming Next: Topic 1, Risk Management

blocks.zh: Section 1 將深入設施風險評估的具體方法：如何建立 ATMP 設施的正式風險評估（Q1.1），以及如何通過 QRM 原則確定 BSL 要求（Q1.2）。重點將包括：風險評估的跨學科團隊組成、六大風險類別（材料/設施設備/多產品/清潔去污/氣流設計/外部環境），以及 GMO 特殊要求的整合。
blocks.en: Section 1 goes into the specific methods of facility risk assessment: how to establish a formal risk assessment for an ATMP facility (Q1.1) and how to determine BSL requirements through QRM principles (Q1.2). Key points include the composition of a multidisciplinary risk assessment team, the six risk categories (materials/facility and equipment/multi-product/cleaning and decontamination/airflow design/external environment), and the integration of special GMO requirements.
